sentences.en: Small businesses will have to tighten their belts to survive.
sentences.zh: 小企业必须节约开支以求生存。

sentences.en: This light switch needs to be tightened to the wall.
sentences.zh: 这个开关需要固定到墙上。

sentences.en: Critics are coming down hard on tightened economic restrictions.
sentences.zh: 批评者对加强的经济限制措施给予了严厉批评。

senses.zh: 收紧；(使)变紧；(使)绷紧加紧勒紧腰带；省吃俭用
